name: cs
description: cs's in-session mod: the rotate band above the prompt, forced rotation past CS_ROTATE_FORCE_CTX, and the wrap key

bandPrompt.title: Band: named prompt
bandPrompt.description: "latest" (default): the band names the newest prompt and draws its bar thick. "read": it names the prompt being read, the one whose row stands highest on screen, and follows your scroll.

bandBars.title: Band: most bars
bandBars.description: The most prompt bars the band draws (default 10); older prompts fold into one …N run. A whole number of 1 or more.
